# U.S. Department of Education

> The federal agency providing comprehensive education resources, financial aid guidance, and policy support across K-12, higher education, adult learning, and career pathways.

Ed.gov serves as the authoritative source for federal education programs, student financial aid administration, and educational policy for the Trump-Vance Administration. The site aggregates resources from multiple offices including Federal Student Aid, the Office of Adult Education & Literacy (AEFLA), and the Office for Civil Rights.

## Key Topics

- FAFSA
- Federal Student Aid
- Student Loans
- Higher Education
- Financial Aid
- Career Pathways
- Workforce Development
- Community Colleges
- Veterans Education
- Military Families
- Adult Education
- Early Childhood Education
- College Search
- Student Success
- Grants

## Higher Education & Financial Aid

- [Higher Education](https://www.ed.gov/higher-education): Main higher education hub covering college search, FAFSA, student loans, grants, and financial aid.
- [Paying for College](https://www.ed.gov/higher-education/paying-college): College financing resources covering FAFSA, Pell Grants, and federal student aid estimation.
- [Find a College or Educational Program](https://www.ed.gov/higher-education/find-college-or-educational-program): College search and comparison resources including College Scorecard and accreditation information.
- [Manage Your Loans](https://www.ed.gov/higher-education/manage-your-loans): Student loan management guide covering repayment plans, forgiveness, and consolidation options.
- [1098-E Tax Form](https://www.ed.gov/higher-education/manage-your-loans/_098-e-tax-form): 1098-E and 1098-T tax form information for student loan interest deductions and tuition credits.

## Career Development & Workforce

- [Career Pathways](https://www.ed.gov/higher-education/career-pathways): Career technical education and apprenticeship resources for high-skill, high-wage occupations.
- [Community College](https://www.ed.gov/higher-education/find-college-or-educational-program/community-college): Community college pathways and workforce development training aligned to in-demand sectors.
- [Adult Programs](https://www.ed.gov/adult-programs): Adult education and literacy programs covering basic skills and workforce development pathways.

## Veterans & Military Support

- [Veterans and Military Families](https://www.ed.gov/higher-education/veterans-and-military-families): Education benefits and financial aid resources for veterans and military families.
- [Education Benefits for Military Personnel and their Families](https://www.ed.gov/higher-education/veterans-and-military-families/education-benefits-military-personnel-and-their-families): GI Bill, Yellow Ribbon Program, and military education funding information and support resources.
- [8 Keys to Veterans' Success](https://www.ed.gov/higher-education/veterans-and-military-families/_-keys-to-veterans-success-sites): Best practices for postsecondary institutions supporting veteran transition and college completion.

## K-12 & Early Childhood Education

- [Birth to Grade 12 Education](https://www.ed.gov/birth-to-grade-12-education): K-12 education hub covering preschool through high school, school choice, and family engagement.
- [Early Childhood Education](https://www.ed.gov/birth-to-grade-12-education/early-childhood-education): Early childhood education resources from birth through 3rd grade with social-emotional learning.
- [Early Learning](https://www.ed.gov/birth-to-grade-12-education/early-childhood-education/early-learning-home-page): Early learning programs covering infants, toddlers, preschool, and disabilities services.

## Adult Education & Literacy

- [Office of Adult Education & Literacy](https://aefla.ed.gov): Adult Education and Family Literacy Act office portal for program guidance and announcements.
- [Correctional Education](https://aefla.ed.gov/correctional-education): Correctional education programs in prisons and juvenile justice facilities with federal funding overview.

## Agency & Portal

- [Home](https://www.ed.gov): U.S. Department of Education homepage with news, policy updates, and federal education agency information.
